epic.title: Epic #418, wave 5 (final wave)
epic.intent_and_why: There is no way to ask 'is this project set up to run Constellation' and get a checkable answer -- the wiring that activates capabilities can live somewhere that does not ship, and the gap is found by an agent failing rather than a check refusing.

definition_of_done: A readiness check reports and refuses with a named reason on an unready checkout; never repairs; never touches settings.json.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Report, never repair; distinguish tracked-vs-untracked hook wiring; correctly discriminate interpreter-present-but-pytest-missing
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Unit tests per check function plus one observed refusal against a genuinely fresh clone

hard_constraints: settings.json never touched at any scope (Pre-Ruling 2)
must be observed refusing on a real unready checkout, not just claimed (Pre-Ruling 3)
fixed_decisions: Build the CHECK, not the stronger fresh-clone-produces-a-reading fix (Pre-Ruling 1)
Prefer a mode of install_constellation.py over a new script (Pre-Ruling 4)

current_wave.objective: Wave 5 (epic #418 close-to-w5): ship the shipping half of the governor mechanism that #419/#440/#488/#467 already built
exit_criteria: #458's readiness check exists, is tested, and was observed refusing on a real unready checkout

issues.title: constellation-readiness: a checkable answer to 'is this project set up to run Constellation'
issues.desired_outcome: One command reports readiness and refuses with a named reason when not ready.
issues.useful_now: Every governor observation epic #418 has made so far came from configuration that does not ship; this makes that gap checkable instead of discoverable-by-failure.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: python scripts/install_constellation.py --check-readiness refuses (exit 1) with named per-item reasons on an unready checkout, and passes when all four items are ready.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose the exact four-item shape and CLI flag name; preserve the report-only, no-settings.json-write boundary.

completed_outcomes.outcome: Readiness-check mode (--check-readiness) added to scripts/install_constellation.py: four independently-testable check functions (engine-runnable via sys.executable, skills-installed-and-registered, hooks-wired-in-a-file-that-ships with distinct tracked/user-scope tests, work-area-present via .git) plus a thin CLI/report layer. 25 new tests, 132/132 file passes (380 subtests), independent reviewer APPROVE with 0 findings (mutation-tested the engine-runnable discrimination, ran the CLI end-to-end).
completed_outcomes.evidence: g1-implement-result.json, g1-review-result.json (checklist-engine consolidated review at .agent-work/issue-458-readiness/g1-review/review.json), fresh-clone-refusal evidence e-g1-integrate-1

wave_evidence.claim: The readiness check refuses with a named reason on a genuinely unready checkout (Pre-Ruling 3).
wave_evidence.expected: Nonzero exit, per-item NOT READY reasons naming what is missing.
wave_evidence.observed: Cloned constellation-skills fresh from GitHub (commit 7f4a80f9) to a scratch directory, ran `python scripts/install_constellation.py --agent claude --scope project --project <clone> --check-readiness`: exit 1, skills NOT READY (no .claude/skills at target), hooks NOT READY (Context Governor hooks UNWIRED), work_area READY (.git present), engine READY (environment-scoped -- reflects the executing agent's own interpreter, not the clone's tree, exactly as anticipated in MISSION_FRAME.md before this run).
wave_evidence.source: Commander-run fresh-clone test at g1-integrate; independently reproduced test suite runs (25/25 readiness, 132/132 file)

wave_evidence.claim: The environment-scoped items (engine, hooks) cannot be exercised by a fresh clone alone -- only tree-scoped items (skills, work_area) can.
wave_evidence.expected: A cold plan critic finding, folded into the plan before g1 was dispatched.
wave_evidence.observed: Confirmed exactly by the fresh-clone run above: skills and work_area behaved as tree-scoped predictions; engine and hooks reflected this agent's own environment, not the clone's tree.
wave_evidence.source: plan-alternatives.md cold-critic fold-in; confirmed empirically at g1-integrate
